note: The fixed scenes of the performance budget (docs/design/performance.md), measured by `dyno bench`. cameras: names in tools/concepts/cameras.json (the gauntlet's gameplay cameras). flight: straight runs between points, metres from the world's hearth (x east, z south), a few metres over the ground. default_tier: the quality tier a new player on a discrete card gets, which the budgets hold; the tiers themselves are the options panel's presets (crates/dyno-client/src/options.rs). The world is the one a fresh server builds from the pack's layout.
